positions.commentary: The speaker believes Tesla will disrupt the utility industry by enabling residential solar and storage combined with software for grid management.
The speaker cites Amazon AWS as a critical technology that enabled trillions of dollars of value creation between 2005 and 2011.
The speaker identifies Google's Android as a critical technology that reached significant scale and enabled trillions of dollars of value creation.
The speaker mentions Apple's iOS alongside other technologies but does not express a specific bullish or bearish view on Meta.
The speaker predicts that the disruption of utilities will cause hundreds of billions of dollars of debt to go sideways and drive bankruptcies.
The speaker mentions PG&E as an example of a utility that will face bankruptcy but does not mention CSU.
